item.title: Things Many People Find Too Obvious To Have Told You Already — via awesome-falsehood
item.description: Reads like a list of falsehoods about the tech business: “There is no hidden reserve of smart people who know what they're doing, anywhere. Not in government, not in science, not in tech, (…) nowhere.”

item.title: What every software engineer should know about search — via awesome-falsehood
item.description: A better sourced article on the difficulty of implementing search engines.

item.title: Enclave and exclave — via awesome-falsehood
item.description: “Residing in an enclave within another country has often involved difficulties in such areas as passage rights, importing goods, currency, provision of utilities and health services, and host nation cooperation.” None of these attributes follows from a country code.
